name: ai-design-system-demo
description: Demo repository: a design system as code, evolved with an AI agent through branches and reviewed pull requests.
author: Florian Gouloubi

scripts.typecheck: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck -w @demo-ds/react
scripts.build-storybook: npm run tokens:build && storybook build -o storybook-static --quiet
scripts.ci: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:css && npm run test && npm run build-storybook
scripts.mcp:build: npm run build -w @bridge/mcp && npm run build -w @bridge/cli
scripts.mcp:test: npm run mcp:build && vitest run --config packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts
